narrative.intro: BP Oil International shows $379M in federal contract obligations for FY26 to date. The FY26 total is reported as fiscal year to date, so the figure represents a partial-year total. The award count and the average award size indicate that a small number of large awards account for the current-year obligations. The year-to-year sequence shows higher totals in FY22 and FY21, lower amounts in FY23 and FY24, and a substantial rise in the FY26 to date total. Contracting teams and program managers focused on BP Oil International should track award timing and remaining periods of performance because the concentration implied by an average award size of $47.4M can affect pipeline planning and resource allocation.
